description: Hazesa wears an ivory floor-length gown with a low square neckline, elbow sleeves and gold geometric embroidery across the bodice, cuffs and skirt borders. An ornate woven belt with a large circular buckle marks the waist. An ochre embroidered wrap rests along the arms. Small gold earrings, a restrained pendant necklace and bracelets complement the fabric; decorated leather sandals remain visible at the hem.
